change_2_test_normal_decode_uses_chunk_p.judgement: PARTIALLY WEAKENED. The 'chunk path is used' property is preserved and strengthened (now also proves one physical open and exact cells). But the original ALSO asserted the requested chunk size was honoured (`chunksize == 2`); the rewritten test runs on a 3-row carrier where the whole file fits in one read, and asserts only `chunk_reads >= 1`, so a chunk-size regression would no longer be caught.
change_2_test_normal_decode_uses_chunk_p.mitigation_verified_by_reviewer: the underlying behaviour IS correct — independently measured on a 1000-row carrier: chunk_rows=7 yields 143 chunks all <=7, chunk_rows=100 yields 10 chunks of 100, rows conserved. So this is a TEST-COVERAGE regression, not a behaviour regression.
change_2_test_normal_decode_uses_chunk_p.verdict: COVERAGE WEAKENED — recommend restoring an explicit chunk-size assertion on a carrier larger than one chunk
